meta.title: KrachtigFit — Personal trainer in Herten and online
meta.description: Get stronger without upending your life. Strength training, nutrition guidance and weekly check-ins, built around the schedule you already have. Book a free intro call.

about.headline: Hi, I'm Sander.
about.intro: I'm the trainer behind KrachtigFit. No complicated schedules and no guilt over an off week — just an approach that fits a normal life with work, family, and everything in between.

hero.headline: Get stronger without upending your life.
hero.subhead: Strength training, nutrition guidance and weekly check-ins — built around the schedule you already have. In Herten or fully online.

proof.successLabel: met the goal agreed at intake

method.headline: Three things, every week, consistently.
method.intro: No crash diet and no two hours a day in the gym. Three components that reinforce each other — and that hold up alongside a job and a family.

training.title: Strength training that respects your time
training.body: Three 45-minute sessions a week. At home, at a gym, or with me — the programme is built around your situation, not the other way around.

nutrition.title: Food logging without the obsession
nutrition.body: You learn to see what you eat instead of submitting to it. No banned lists. Just awareness, and choices you make yourself.

checkin.title: Weekly course correction
checkin.body: Fifteen minutes a week looking at what worked and what didn't. A bad week is data, not failure. We adjust and carry on.

programs.headline: Three ways to work together.
programs.intro: All three run on the same method. The difference is how often you see me in person.

online.title: Online
online.body: Fully remote. A training plan built for you, feedback on your food log, and a weekly video call. Works anywhere, including if you travel a lot.

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.body: Twice a month training together in Herten, the rest online. You get the corrections that only happen in person, with the flexibility of remote coaching.

personal.title: One-to-one
personal.body: Training together every week. The fastest route if you're starting from zero, working around an injury, or you simply want eyes on every rep.

pricing.headline: What it costs, published on the site.
pricing.intro: No intro call required just to hear a number. All prices include VAT, per month, cancel monthly.
pricing.withdrawalNote: You have {days} days to withdraw after the agreement is concluded. Cancel within that period and you pay only pro rata for what you've used.
pricing.notSure: Not sure which programme fits? Book a free intro call and I'll tell you honestly — including if I'm not the right fit for you.

faq.headline: What people usually want to know.
faq.contactLine: Question not covered? Email me at

gym.q: Do I need a gym membership?
gym.a: No. I write programmes for both home and gym. Many online clients train at home with a set of dumbbells and a resistance band. If you do have a membership, we'll use it.

firstWeek.q: What happens in the first week?
firstWeek.a: After the intro call you get your starter plan within 48 hours: your first week of training, a short guide to food logging, and a slot booked for the first check-in. One step at a time.

beginner.q: Is this suitable if I've never trained before?
beginner.a: Yes. Most people who start with me have little or no strength training experience. We begin where you are and build at your pace.

time.q: How much time does it take per week?
time.a: Roughly three to four hours. Three 45-minute sessions, five to ten minutes a day for your food log, and fifteen minutes for the weekly check-in.

travel.q: Does this work if I travel a lot?
travel.a: Yes. Online and hybrid are built for it. Sessions adapt to a hotel gym or a hotel room, food logging works anywhere, and the check-in happens over video or message.

notSure.a: Book an intro call and decide afterwards. It's free and there's no obligation. If I'm not the right person for you, I'll say so — and point you somewhere better.

cancel.a: Yes. You have a {days}-day statutory cooling-off period after the agreement is concluded, and after that it's cancellable monthly. No annual contract.
